instructions: After reading flagged movements and pinned git histories, add reviewed mappings. Never infer causation from a PR title or changed path alone. Unmapped moves remain explicitly unattributed. A mapping needs metric (fnmatch pattern), component (model or data), prs and/or commits, reason, reviewer; optionally effect (fnmatch pattern) and years (fiscal-year start integers). Both components must be covered to attribute a total_change edge.

example_only_do_not_copy_as_evidence.reason: Explain the changed formula/input and direction, with reviewed evidence.
